comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, one customer accounted for approximately 24% and another for 16% of total consolidated accounts receivable, though the Company does not believe these balances represent significant credit risk due to past collection experience.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose significant customer concentration in accounts receivable for fiscal year 2024, though the magnitude and specific metrics differ. AVGO reports a single customer representing 18% of net accounts receivable as of November 3, 2024, and 28% of net revenue for the year. AMD discloses that one customer accounted for approximately 24% of total consolidated accounts receivable as of December 28, 2024, but does not quantify the percentage of revenue from that specific customer, instead noting that it does not believe these balances represent significant credit risk.

sentences.text: One customer accounted for 18% and 21% of our net accounts receivable balance as of November 3, 2024 and October 29, 2023, respectively.
During fiscal years 2024, 2023 and 2022, one customer accounted for 28%, 21% and 20% of our net revenue, respectively.
One customer accounted for approximately 24% and another customer accounted for 16% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, respectively.
However, the Company does not believe the receivable balance from these customers represents a significant credit risk based on past collection experience and review of their current credit quality.

comparisons.peer_summary: A substantial majority of trade receivables come from OEMs and ODMs, with the three largest customers representing 47% of net accounts receivable as of December 28, 2024, which management believes does not represent significant credit risk.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC disclose customer concentration risks within accounts receivable. AVGO identifies a single customer accounting for 18% of net accounts receivable and 28% of net revenue in fiscal 2024. INTC discloses that its three largest customers collectively represent 47% of net accounts receivable as of December 28, 2024, but management believes this does not represent significant credit risk. AVGO does not provide a credit risk mitigation opinion in the cited text, whereas INTC explicitly cites cash flow forecasts and past collection experience to mitigate the perceived risk of its higher concentration.

sentences.text: One customer accounted for 18% and 21% of our net accounts receivable balance as of November 3, 2024 and October 29, 2023, respectively.

A substantial majority of our trade receivables are derived from sales to OEMs and ODMs. We also have accounts receivable derived from sales to industrial and communications equipment manufacturers in the computing and communications industries.

We believe the net accounts receivable balances from our three largest customers (47% as of December 28, 2024) do not represent a significant credit risk, based on cash flow forecasts, balance sheet analysis, and past collection experience.
